pages.summary: No.

pages.title: Does Morloc allow function-specific containerized environments?
pages.summary: No, unlike workflow managers such as Snakemake and Nextflow, Morloc does not offer function-specific environments.

pages.title: I’m not a human, do I still need Morloc?
